translated_title: Cerimedo’s Influence on Mexico’s Electoral Processes Could Be Reviewed, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Consideran revisar influencia de Cerimedo en procesos electorales: Sheinbaum
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: After Chile moved to investigate Argentine consultant Fernando Cerimedo, Sheinbaum said Mexico’s Congress could examine his role in online disinformation against her.
